blocking_decisions.title: Bundle-generation round-identity lifecycle is self-invalidating under the approved D-Approval-Commits/D-Bundle-Manifest contract
blocking_decisions.summary: record_bundle_generation's mandatory post-generation durability commit for reviewed_implementation_head/implementation_revision can never satisfy /approve-review implementation's and assert_local_generation_matches's exact-equality gates simultaneously -- proven to recur on every round (round 8 durability commit 20f89de, round 9 durability commit 4d7b3cf, both immediately re-stale under the same repository-local staleness rule). Not fixable within the current approved invariant; requires relaxing D-Approval-Commits' exact-equality rule.
